title: Enterprise Computer-Use & Browser GUI Agent Selection: Pruned A11y Tree vs. Pure Pixel VLM vs. Hybrid OmniParser v2 Set-of-Mark (SoM)

workload_basis.benchmark: Enterprise WebArena + OSWorld Hybrid Task Suite

tiers.tier: Tier 1: Raw Full-DOM HTML Dump (Unpruned innerHTML to Text LLM)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Anti-pattern (SPA HTML noise blows up context window and confuses action grounding)

tiers.tier: Tier 2: Pure Pixel Screenshot VLM Loop (Direct (x, y) Coordinate Regression)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Legacy desktop / Citrix / VDI apps with zero DOM access (suffers from tiny-icon click drift)

tiers.tier: Tier 3: Pruned Accessibility (A11y) Tree Snapshot (Playwright aria-ref IDs Only)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Standard semantic web apps with well-labelled ARIA attributes

tiers.tier: Tier 4 (Recommended): Hybrid A11y Tree + OmniParser v2 Set-of-Mark (SoM) + Multi-Action Batching
tiers.recommended_scenario: Enterprise Browser & Desktop RPA combining fast DOM refs with visual SoM box grounding
